evaluation_protocol.readout: own-model train-only K0 uniform kNN; fit-only standardized features/targets
evaluation_protocol.failure_policy: finite prefix, NaN suffix, explicit coverage

model_provenance.label: H-JEPA matched-history official-core adaptation

upstream.source_status: byte-exact text files; binary example GIFs omitted

adaptations: LeHami ConvEncoder replaces original ViT;64px RGB scaled to[-1,1]
21-frame causal GRU windows replace native per-frame perceptual encoding
Previous anchor window repeats its oldest available raw frame once
CNN training BatchNorm is computed separately per raw time index
One matched anchor instead of all sequence starts in the official loss
Native PIC uses observed target phases only in its auxiliary training loss
Inference only encodes initial21 frames; autonomous two-state recurrence
Feature readout uses[s_t,s_t-s_previous], the complete recurrence state
Passive zero actions only;physical dt=.1, native normalized Euler dt=1
Native predictor state-detach behavior preserved;not an official benchmark reproduction

calibration.standardization: Fit288 groups only; feature/target std floor1e-6

val.aggregation: Equal record/time weights on complete support; paired conditions share initial groups and are not independent samples

metrics_scope: Future frames exclude anchor; incomplete trajectories reduce coverage and retain NaN suffix; matched-support trivial baselines
limitations: Matched K0 readout differs from author-native evaluation protocols.
Observed-history reconstruction is diagnostic, not autonomous prediction or a strict error lower bound.
kNN maps finite off-manifold queries to training labels; inspect teacher quality and nearest-fit distances.
Each model owns a train-only readout; no shared latent-space readout weights.
No test/unseen data is used for fitting, selection or evaluation.
